# OptiFlow (formerly TechServJo)
> Enterprise AI Automation, Voice AI Agents, n8n Workflows & Intelligent Process Automation in Jordan, Saudi Arabia & the MENA region.

## Overview
OptiFlow (https://tech.optiflow.cc) is a premier AI automation agency and enterprise systems integrator based in Amman, Jordan and Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. OptiFlow specializes in:
- Autonomous Voice AI Agents for inbound and outbound phone calls (Arabic dialects including Jordanian, Saudi, Gulf, MSA, and English).
- Enterprise WhatsApp Business Automation (Cloud API) with autonomous conversational AI agents.
- Self-hosted n8n workflow architecture replacing Zapier and Make with up to 85% cost savings and complete data sovereignty (Saudi PDPL & Jordan Data Protection Law compliant).
- AI OCR & Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) for invoices, receipts, and automated ERP reconciliation (Odoo, Zoho Books, SAP).
- CRM and ERP integrations for real estate, logistics, medical clinics, and trading companies.
